note: DSB only, as before: Hakrinbank's and Finabank's card terms weren't reached in this pass. De Surinaamsche Bank's information sheet (April 2025), read in full: the two cards it offers individuals, the DSB Classic and Gold Mastercard credit cards, in US dollars, with a membership of 50 and 60 dollars a year; a balance on which only the minimum is paid bears 1¼% in finance charges, written as a month's rate, the statement being monthly (paying in full costs nothing); the minimum payment is 4% of the balance outstanding; a cash advance or transfer from the card costs 2% of it, at least 5 dollars. The Corporate card, for businesses, isn't written. VAT is 0% on these charges unless stated. No grace period, late fee or foreign transaction fee is stated.
